exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: School Did you go to secondary/high school near to where you lived? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: School What did you like about your secondary/high school? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Tell me about anything you didn’t like at your school. How do you think your school could be improved? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe something you don’t have now but would really like to own in the future. You should say: what this thing is how long you have wanted to own it where you first saw it and explain why you would like to own it.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: Owning things What types of things do young people in your country most want to own today? Why is this?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Owning things Why do some people feel they need to own things?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Owning things Do you think that owning lots of things makes people happy? Why?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Owning things Do you think television and films can make people want to get new possessions? Why do they have this effect?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Owning things Are there any benefits to society of people wanting to get new possessions? Why do you think this is?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Owning things Do you think people will consider that having lots of possessions is a sign of success in the future? Why?
